ModMetaData.name: Ecotech (Local)
ModMetaData.author: Sepphoris,NightmareCorporation
ModMetaData.description:
Mod Version: 1.0.6 (last updated @ 1.14.2025, ~2:30PM PST)
====================
A high fantasy, tribal-oriented mod that introduces the ability to grow weapons and defenses in your garden, rather than machining them together.
Currently introduces several terraweapons, new materials, and new structures, all of which only require a green thumb to plant, and patience to grow. They are just as effective as fabricated weapons, giving you a 100% all-natural, viable alternative to your colony defenses.
No more need to be forced into higher tech levels to defend yourself! The goal of this mod is to provide a tribal-friendly way of upscaling your colony, while also being balanced.
====================
Current Update: -(Major) Added messages that will appear after you research certain things, which will explain how to use the more unintuitive additions. This should help alleviate confusion!
Last Minor Update: -Fixed two recipes missing in the Terravat.
Last Major Features and Changes:
-Completely overhauled weapon sounds. They will now sound sharp and fast, opposed to their former 'Blowgun' sound. Note that the shotgun still doesn't have a dedicated sound; I will add it in as soon as I get a suitable one! -Due to popular request, removed maximum tech levels for plants and growable structures. You can now use EcoTech at any tech level. I will revisit tribal exclusivity later on.
====================
-Please report balancing and bug issues on the workshop page!
